Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 5, Verse 14

“The Lord creates neither the agency nor the actions of the world, nor the union of actions with their fruits. It is nature that proceeds of itself.”

Krishna declines responsibility for the human predicament in unusually flat terms. The machinery of deeds and consequences runs on its own; svabhava is what moves.
